sequence: take device mutex, clear IRQ status, stop playback, release device mutex
disable RTP almost-full interrupt, set loop flag to zero, select RTP mode and gain
queue richtap_rtp_work at state+0x648 on state+0x448 workqueue
stock_sequence.conditional_legacy_branch: The threaded handler may consume aw_rtp when IRQ status is clear, state+0x5 is 1, and play mode is 2. The stock stop callback does not clear state+0x5.

previous_candidate_gap.description: The ioctl wrapper released haptic_irq_stop_lock immediately after the stock ioctl queued +0x648. A pending IRQ thread could win the mutex before richtap_rtp_work acquired it and observe mode 2 with loop flag 0 and a possibly stale state+0x5.

candidate_correction.arming_gate: For ioctl 0x520a, set haptic_richtap_arming while holding haptic_irq_stop_lock and before invoking the stock-exact ioctl body.
candidate_correction.irq_thread: Wait on haptic_richtap_arming_idle without holding haptic_irq_stop_lock; acquire the mutex only after the gate clears; recheck the gate and shutdown state under the mutex before calling irq_handle_stock_exact.
candidate_correction.worker_completion: richtap_rtp_work clears the gate and wakes waiters on shutdown, validation/start failures, and successful initial stream setup. Non-shutdown failure paths disable AEI and clear chip IRQ status before waking the handler.
candidate_correction.teardown: The shutdown gate wakes the IRQ waitqueue; probe resets the arming flag before publishing a new device instance.
static_order: stock ioctl initializes RTP state and queues +0x648
pending IRQ thread waits without holding the mutex
worker completes the start/data/AEI/loop transition and clears the gate while holding the mutex
IRQ thread wakes, acquires the mutex, rechecks the gate, and dispatches the stock handler

residual_risks: The worker still holds haptic_irq_stop_lock over the hardware start poll and initial data setup; the timeout path requests approximately 602.5-752.6 ms of sleep, plus I2C and scheduling time. This remains a threaded-IRQ latency risk.
The candidate has not been installed or exercised on the NX809J; runtime race closure and Lockdep behavior remain unverified.
The HAL writer was not observed during the tested Android prebaked effect; a path-specific TikTap/Richtap event remains untraced.
The HAL FIFO state store/load ordering remains unpaired with the kernel acquire/release operations.
Strict stock import parity and independent review remain incomplete.
